description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.links parity (extract_links only, structural IDs).
known_parity_gaps: python_int_outside_i64: Python int is unbounded; values outside i64 are not representable in Rust ObjectValue::Int — no required vector.
lone_surrogate_target: a lone UTF-16 surrogate cannot be stored in Rust str — no required vector.
unicode_line_separator_strip: pinned Rust python_str_strip omits U+2028/U+2029 from strip; Python str.strip removes them — documented gap, not a required vector.
